verdict.unattributed_status_justification: Single-path BFS in QA bundle traverses engine segmentationCache. Unrendered peer sentinels drop to 0 occurrences post-logout, supporting the hypothesis that the underlying FinanceExpense model instance was freed by app provider. However, by readiness §4.4 and AGENTS.md, residual risk remains officially unattributed because single-path BFS does not establish full exhaustiveness and native Dart VM is NOT RUN.
